conditions.data: Synthetic; equal-sized target and unrelated courses; three rows share each timestamp; fixed structured answers
conditions.scope: Repository only, warmed loopback pool; not browser, authentication middleware, cold-start or production SLO
conditions.otherIndexes: Separate course/user indexes and primary keys; replace ordering index without increasing index count
conditions.maintenance: VACUUM ANALYZE before each scale, then warmups; no concurrent benchmark writers
